kmuc_matching.native_task: Patient lay text to department/doctor retrieval
kmuc_matching.metric_formula: dept_top1 = correct_top1 / N; hit@5 = any_correct_in_top5 / N; MRR = mean(1 / rank_expected_dept)
kmuc_matching.required_inputs: lay/patient text, expected department, candidate doctor/procedure/ICD index
kmuc_matching.applicability_rule: computed only when patient text, expected department, and the same candidate index are available
kmuc_matching.portability: Portable only when department labels and the same doctor/procedure index are available.

medsynth_dial_note.native_task: Dial-2-Note and Note-2-Dial fine-tuning on Aci-Bench
medsynth_dial_note.core_metric: LLM jury preference rate; optional BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR
medsynth_dial_note.metric_formula: win_rate = preferred_outputs / judged_outputs; text metrics use standard BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR against target notes/dialogues
medsynth_dial_note.required_inputs: paired dialogue and note, trainable generation model, Aci-Bench train/test, LLM judges
medsynth_dial_note.applicability_rule: computed only for paired dialogue-note datasets or adapters that can produce both directions
medsynth_dial_note.portability: Expensive and task-specific; not directly applicable to datasets without dialogue-note pairs.

simsum_symptom_ie.core_metric: F1 for dyspnea, cough, pain, nasal, fever; macro F1 for fever
simsum_symptom_ie.metric_formula: F1_symptom = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall); macro_f1 = mean(F1_dyspnea, F1_cough, F1_pain, F1_nasal, F1_fever)
simsum_symptom_ie.required_inputs: note text plus five respiratory symptom labels or spans
simsum_symptom_ie.applicability_rule: computed only when notes expose gold respiratory symptom labels or span annotations
simsum_symptom_ie.portability: Portable to respiratory datasets with symptom labels; otherwise requires label projection or manual annotation.

synthea_structured_ehr.native_task: Structured synthetic EHR generation and standards-based interoperability
synthea_structured_ehr.required_inputs: patient, encounter, condition, procedure, drug, observation tables or equivalent FHIR/OMOP fields
synthea_structured_ehr.applicability_rule: computed when structured EHR fields support patient, visit, condition, procedure, drug, and observation domains
synthea_structured_ehr.portability: Portable to structured EHR/claims datasets; not applicable to pure text datasets.
